svg.title: Jogge di Balla
svg.desc: A service order travels to a kitchen screen and receipt printer. Made to be used. Personal projects, out in the world. Jogge di Balla Co-founder & vice president. Concept, design, development, operation. A club website grew into our everyday toolkit: memberships, events, orders connecting service, kitchen and bar, live photos and streaming overlays.

g.aria-label: Personal projects, out in the world.
